title: A Space that runs out of monthly bookings hears about it the first time a booker is turned away

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-21: checkSpaceBookingMeter refuses the booker with 'This Space has taken all the bookings its plan includes this month' and nobody tells the owner. Once the gates go live (free plan is 15 a month, LIVE-2390), a free Space silently loses customers. Fix: a once-a-month owner notice with the count of turned-away bookers and the Business upgrade; this is the clearest upgrade trigger booking has.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
